task_instance: Build and run a 4-project portfolio health review: create a realistic sample_project_data.json (budgets, timelines, scope, quality metrics, risk register, resource allocations for 4 projects), implement the skill's three Tier scripts (project_health_dashboard.py with weighted timeline/budget/scope/quality/risk scoring and RAG thresholds; risk_matrix_analyzer.py with EMV calculation, category weighting, and Avoid/Mitigate/Transfer/Accept response strategy per the skill's formulas; resource_capacity_planner.py with 70-85% target utilization band and over/under-allocation flags), then run all three against the sample data and verify the outputs.
evidence: Created assets/sample_project_data.json (4 projects: Customer Portal Modernization, Data Platform Migration, Mobile App Revamp, Internal AI Assistant Rollout) with budget/timeline/scope/quality/risks/resources fields. Implemented scripts/project_health_dashboard.py, scripts/risk_matrix_analyzer.py, scripts/resource_capacity_planner.py using the exact weighting scheme, thresholds, and formulas given in SKILL.md (25/25/20/20/10 dimension weights, RAG thresholds composite>80/60-80/<60 with dimension floors, category weights Technical 1.2/Resource 1.1/Financial 1.4/Schedule 1.0, risk response thresholds Avoid>18/Mitigate12-18/Transfer8-12/Accept<8, utilization target band 70-85%). Ran: `python3 scripts/project_health_dashboard.py assets/sample_project_data.json > health_output.json` (exit 0, produced portfolio_composite_score 45.2, RAG distribution GREEN:1 AMBER:0 RED:3, correctly emitted the skill's STOP-condition warning to stderr for 3 projects with composite <60). Ran `python3 scripts/risk_matrix_analyzer.py assets/sample_project_data.json > risk_output.json` (exit 0, portfolio_total_emv 958000.0, correctly flagged 3 risks exceeding the Avoid threshold >18 with per-risk scores 28.0/24.0/20.0). Ran `python3 scripts/resource_capacity_planner.py assets/sample_project_data.json > capacity_output.json` (exit 0, produced per-role portfolio utilization aggregates and flagged 4 over/under-allocated roles outside the 60-90% band, e.g. ML Engineer 97%, Data Engineer 95%). Verified all three output files are well-formed JSON via `python3 -c "import json; json.load(open(...))"` and by inspecting the printed structures, confirming the numbers matched the input data and the skill's stated formulas. Files produced: assets/sample_project_data.json, scripts/project_health_dashboard.py, scripts/risk_matrix_analyzer.py, scripts/resource_capacity_planner.py, health_output.json, risk_output.json, capacity_output.json, all under the work directory.
